alpha_blend_onto.description: How to handle images with an alpha channel. 'white'/'black' composite onto that background, 'mean' composites onto the ImageNet mean RGB, and 'keep' discards alpha and keeps the original pixel values.

export_point_cloud.description: Return a GLB scene holding the fused coloured point cloud plus a cone mesh per estimated camera.

exclude_keys.description: Keys to omit from each prediction JSON file.

frame_sampling_rate.description: Sample every n-th frame of `video_url`. The first and last frames of the video are always included. Ignored when no video is given.

enable_safety_checker.description: Enable safety checking of the input images and video.

export_prediction_data.description: Return one JSON file per frame with the raw model outputs (camera pose encoding, depth, depth confidence, mask).

image_urls.description: Input images to reconstruct. Accepts JPEG, PNG, WEBP and the other formats Pillow decodes. Images are padded to a square and resized so the longest side is 518 pixels.

video_url.description: Optional input video. Frames are sampled every `frame_sampling_rate`-th frame (the first and last frames are always included) and appended after `image_urls`.

export_depth_maps.description: Return one 16-bit grayscale PNG depth raster per frame. Pixel values map linearly from `depth_range` onto 0-65535.

confidence_percentile.description: Drop this percentage of the lowest-confidence points before building the point cloud. 0 keeps every point.

array_encoding.description: How arrays are encoded inside the prediction JSON files. 'base64' emits {data, shape, dtype} objects; 'list' emits nested JSON lists, which are far larger.

max_points.description: Upper bound on the number of points written to the GLB. Points above the default 250,000-point budget are evenly subsampled to limit GLB serialization and upload latency.
